items.title: Consolidate .env to the repository root
Make the container spec files Quay-compatible
Deterministic responses for the release harness (HARNESS_NOW, /version, stable headers)
Stable log and metrics shape for release-harness A/A runs (M18, M19)
Container image build pipeline with Quay.io registry
A course that does not exist showed "500 Server Error"
A Supabase error's message never reached the log
A hit in one-line content came back with no text
A learning object with order: 0 sorted last instead of first
Wrong line, fence and language from the second match on
Distinguish a 404 from an unreachable host when loading a course
State that quizzes are a formative self-check, not assessment
Promote the judged rc image on a final tag instead of rebuilding
Keep variable data out of log messages and guard it with a test
Include the time app in the build check and the registry wait
Add ESLint no-console rule and standardise error catching
Route the course calendar through the clock seam; keep the commit off /_app/version.json
Migration expand/contract checks and artefact-tagged changelog entries
Send digests, rules_url and 5 runs to the harness (time digest on deploy)
Local Grafana stack for Tutors learning insights
Rebuild Tutors with the Paper design system
Load the scene, follow dark mode, match the Paper UI (supersedes #304)
Enable rls public tables
Make phones and tablets fit: two-up cards, scroll-away header, no keyboard hints on touch
Rationalised the connect, course home and course tools menus
Course shell mobile header
Let the image backfill accept V16.2.1 and 16.2.1
Generate the release changelog from merged PRs and their EARS Rules
Sign and attest the digest before tagging it
Error reports flushed on page unload reach app_errors
Name Netlify builds after their commit
Pnpm release:candidate, release/deployed.json and the release SOP
Bring time, catalogue and live onto the Paper design system and the reader's UX patterns
Title the sign-in page and claim the Paper rebuild's accessibility fixes
Configure next deployment URLs at runtime
Combine open Dependabot updates (#356–#362, supersedes #294)
Distinct landmark and control names in the course shell
Shared vite and svelte config helpers
Move Educator Control into the Learn section
Put a notebook's outline in the sidebar, beside a lab's steps
Badge the online row in course tools, not the account avatar
Add Rules 0237 and 0238 for runnable notebook exercises
Order the side menu Learn, Activity, Companions (Rule 0240)
Remediate dependency advisories and reader warnings
Drop the backward-compat type aliases
Rewrite the stale README
Keep footer at viewport bottom on short pages
Walk the whole shell and the cards on the page
Combine Dependabot bumps #402 #403 #404 #406 #407 #410
